samples.summary: `height` is accepted but is a silent no-op under Tailwind preflight, contradicting the plugin's own "decline rather than silently ignore" principle. The design doc addition (docs/design/notes/notes.md:459-467) admits that preflight's `img { height: auto }` outranks the presentational hint from an HTML `height` attribute, so `` parses, renders, and does nothing visible — exactly the "render at intrinsic size with no hint why" failure the module doc cites as the reason it refuses `style="width:200px"` instead of dropping it. The change either should override preflight for preview images (the doc explicitly punts: "left alone as a separate call") or not admit `height` into the allowlist. Cost stays inside a corner case since width sizing — the issue's stated case — does work.
samples.evidence: img-plugin.ts: `if (height !== undefined && !DIMENSION_RE.test(height)) return false;` … `token.attrs.push(['height', height])`; notes.md: "a lone `height` … does not force a hard height … Overriding preflight for preview images was left alone as a separate call."

samples.summary: Two tests and the module's regex comment narrate a regression history that never existed in this repository — the file is brand new in this diff, so there is no "earlier `(\s[^<>]*?)?\s*\/?>`" that "froze every other collaborator's preview" and no "This run took around eleven seconds then". Presenting an in-development iteration as shipped-and-fixed history in comments and in `docs/design`-adjacent prose misleads future readers about what the code has actually done in production. Trim to a plain statement of the invariant the regex shape maintains.
samples.evidence: img-plugin.test.ts: "Regression: the tag regex used to end in `[^<>]*?` … a note one collaborator saved froze every other collaborator's synchronous `render()`. This run took around eleven seconds then"; img-plugin.ts: "an earlier `(\s[^<>]*?)?\s*\/?>` put two whitespace-matching quantifiers side by side"

samples.summary: The allowlist omits `title`, which markdown-it's own `![alt](src "title")` path supports and which appears in pasted GitHub/MDN `` snippets alongside `align`/`class`. Not required by the issue (sizing), and declining is safe and documented behavior, so this is only a completeness note — but the module doc lists no rationale for excluding `title` specifically while the `![]()` form accepts it, which is a small asymmetry between the two image paths.
